items.title: Harbor City approves electric bus order
Ocho bibliotecas amplían su horario durante un piloto
Water utility reports early leak-detection results

https://example.invalid/news/buses.text: Harbor City's council approved an order for 120 electric buses on Tuesday. The city will spend $18 million from an existing transport fund, with no increase in fares planned. Deliveries are scheduled to begin in March 2027 and finish by December 2027.

https://example.invalid/news/libraries.text: Ocho bibliotecas de Puerto Claro abrirán los domingos durante un programa piloto de tres meses. El piloto comenzará el 4 de octubre de 2026 y tendrá un presupuesto de 240.000 euros.

https://example.invalid/news/water.text: Clearwater Utilities reported that a six-month sensor pilot detected 43 underground leaks in the city water network across two districts. Water loss in those districts was 12% lower than in the same months last year.
